group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed dllseg split/join helpers by induction on nodes_before, plus an at-stop-empty helper by destructing nodes_after. For entail_wit_1 choose the first disjunct, open xizi_dll, and split at linklist_node_pre. For each return witness choose the first disjunct, establish the suffix list shape, join the segments through linklist_node_pre, and close xizi_dll; unfold xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value to discharge the return equality.

forall first prev pivot pivot_prev next stop last prefix suffix, pivot <> NULL -> pivot <> stop -> xizi_dllseg first prev pivot pivot_prev prefix ** xizi_dll_links pivot next pivot_prev ** xizi_dllseg next pivot stop last suffix |-- xizi_dllseg first prev stop last (prefix ++ pivot :: suffix)

premises.discharged_by: The first-disjunct precondition separately owns sentinel and pivot next/prev fields; pivot = stop contradicts separation of overlapping points-to cells.
premises.spatial_resource: sentinel next/prev cells and linklist_node_pre next/prev cells
